references.text: Here God's care for His people is also compared to a shepherd who takes care of his sheep, which resembles the image Jesus uses in Matthew 18:12.
This verse portrays God as a shepherd gathering His people, similar to the image of the shepherd searching for the lost sheep in Matthew 18:12.
The parable of the lost sheep in Luke provides a parallel to the story in Matthew 18:12, focusing on the joy of finding what was lost.
